name: MacKreel's Moonshine
summary: Foggy MacKreel needs his moonshine carried from the broken Thandol Span to Southshore. He drank too much while on watch and now has little time to deliver a fresh batch to Brewmeister Bilger and settle his debt.

sections.title: A Guard's Hangover
sections.body: On the shattered Thandol Span, Foggy MacKreel keeps watch through wet, cold, and dull hours. He drinks his homemade moonshine to bear the damp chill. The brew hits hard enough that he compares its aftereffects to siege engines pounding across his skull. One drink too many leaves him asleep through his shift. Longbraid the Grim commands the dwarves defending the Span, and Foggy cannot afford another lapse in discipline.

sections.title: A Race Against the Clock
sections.body: Foggy owes Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore a longstanding debt. He promised a batch of his personal brew to settle the account, but his hangover and watch duties have left him minutes from missing the deadline. You race across the Arathi Highlands with the jug, by gryphon and swift feet. Reach Southshore before Bilger decides Foggy has skipped out on his tab again.

faq.answer: Foggy MacKreel is a dwarf on the broken part of the Thandol Span, reached from the Arathi Highlands side. He brews extremely stout moonshine and often drinks too freely while on duty.

faq.q: Why is this delivery so urgent?
faq.answer: Foggy passed out drunk during his watch and fell badly behind schedule. He has barely a quarter of an hour to carry the moonshine from the Thandol Span to Southshore and settle his overdue tab with Brewmeister Bilger.

Brewmeister Bilger is a master dwarven brewer in the coastal settlement of Southshore, in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He appreciates stout alcohol and has an outstanding business agreement with Foggy MacKreel.

faq.q: How does one get the moonshine to Southshore in time?
faq.answer: There is no boat from the Span to Southshore. If you know the Refuge Pointe flight path, take a gryphon from Refuge Pointe to Southshore, then find Brewmeister Bilger in town before time runs out.

Longbraid the Grim is the dwarf commander outside Dun Modr in the Wetlands. He leads the defenders of the Thandol Span, and Foggy dreads Longbraid discovering that he drank himself unconscious while on watch.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the misery of a terrible hangover made worse by an unpaid brewing debt to a fellow kinsman.
As an Alliance traveler, you cross the overland route linking the Thandol Span with Alliance-held Southshore in Hillsbrad.
